smoke.scenario: This pay period, biweekly, Texas, single: 8h base @ $40 + 4h night differential @ $48 + 2h night+OT stacked @ $60

annualProjectionSameHoursPerWeek.note: Annual mode treats each block as hours per week times paid weeks (default 52), not as one 14-hour shift.

howToUse: Open the calculator and choose Hourly.
Leave the single rate/hours/OT fields as the default path.
Click “Add rate blocks” under the hourly fields. Existing rate, hours, and OT become the first lines.
Each block has a label (Base, Night, Weekend, Hazard, OT, Night + OT, Custom), hours, and an absolute $/hr rate.
Check Overtime, Differential, or both when those hours are stacked. The checkboxes label the stub line; dollars are always hours times the rate you type.
“This pay period” uses block hours for one paycheck and annualizes by pay frequency. “Annual projection” uses block hours per week times paid weeks.
“Use one rate” returns to the simple fields.
Works on the home calculator and every state/city calculator, including /hourly-paycheck-calculator.
